title: Capture must record a predecessor that declares no dev-login identities

prior_task_context.rollback_drill_receipt: docs/deployment/evidence/S5-ROLLBACK-001/accepted-I-returned.json recorded the 2026-09-17 15:47Z rollback drill state where hosted dev was restored to source commit ae41705b4637110e665d2eed735afbd8307e28e6 with config_posture.dev_login_enabled=false and authenticated_viewer_readback_verified=false.
prior_task_context.deploy_blocker_run: GitHub Actions run 35296324562 failed at dev_release_artifact_driver.py:381 because capture demanded a dedicated viewer client_credentials login probe against a predecessor image that had no dev-login secrets provisioned.

root_cause_analysis.failure_summary: Hosted dev predecessor reports config_posture.dev_login_enabled=false when brought up without dedicated dev-login secrets. Capture unconditionally required a viewer client_credentials probe against that predecessor at dev_release_artifact_driver.py:381, causing all subsequent nonprod-deploy runs to fail with no self-healing path.

reproduction.method: Live read-only probe against https://api.dev.mvl-cap.tw/bff/version confirmed that the hosted dev BFF currently serves source ae41705b4637110e665d2eed735afbd8307e28e6 with config_posture.dev_login_enabled=false and config_posture.auth_mode='strict'. S5-ROLLBACK-001 drill receipt confirmed that this predecessor state genuinely lacks dedicated dev-login credentials.
code_level_evidence: scripts/dev_release_artifact_driver.py:370 _public() previously only verified strict auth negative probes and then immediately proceeded to read PANTHEON_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_VIEWER_CLIENT_ID / PANTHEON_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_VIEWER_CLIENT_SECRET and invoke /bff/auth/dev-login, unconditionally failing when dev_login is disabled on the served predecessor.

scripts/dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py:208 validate_readback() previously hardcoded expected_public with authenticated_viewer_readback_verified=True, rejecting any readback where authenticated_viewer_readback_verified is False even if dev-login was disabled.

root_cause_analysis.determination: The served image itself is the canonical authority on whether a dedicated dev-login identity registry exists. A literal False in config_posture.dev_login_enabled indicates no dedicated identities exist, making viewer login impossible. Capture should record both dev_login_enabled and authenticated_viewer_readback_verified as literal false, while retaining all strict auth, health, and frontend verification checks.

correction.description: Updated scripts/dev_release_artifact_driver.py to check posture.get('dev_login_enabled') is False in _public(). If literal false, it skips the dev-login probe and returns both dev_login_enabled=False and authenticated_viewer_readback_verified=False. Any other value (None, string, int) continues to demand the full viewer round trip. Updated scripts/dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py validate_readback() to accept public.dev_login_enabled as boolean and require authenticated_viewer_readback_verified to equal dev_login_enabled, rejecting mismatched claims.
correction.no_fabricated_readiness: Nothing is fabricated: when dev-login is disabled, authenticated_viewer_readback_verified is explicitly recorded as false rather than claiming a successful login. Strict auth negative probes, exact SHA match, and frontend manifest byte verification remain mandatory on every path.

ac1_capture_and_verify_succeed_with_dev_.proof: test_predecessor_without_dev_login_registry_is_recorded_not_claimed in scripts/test_dev_release_artifact_driver.py verifies capture/verify against dev_login_enabled=False succeeds without invoking /bff/auth/dev-login.

ac2_skipped_viewer_probe_recorded_as_lit.proof: dev_release_artifact_driver.py returns dev_login_enabled=False and authenticated_viewer_readback_verified=False. Verified in test_predecessor_without_dev_login_registry_is_recorded_not_claimed.

ac3_missing_or_non_boolean_demands_full_.proof: test_only_a_literal_false_skips_the_viewer_probe parametrized with [None, 'false', 0, 'no'] confirms that non-literal-boolean values still require the full viewer round trip.

ac4_strict_auth_and_health_remain_mandat.proof: test_declared_dev_login_absence_never_relaxes_strict_denials verifies that negative probes are still strictly enforced even when dev_login_enabled is false.

ac5_compensation_validator_admits_only_m.proof: test_predecessor_without_dev_login_registry_is_a_complete_readback and test_complete_readback_is_required (with mutations login_claimed_without_registry and login_absent_with_registry) in scripts/test_dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py prove only matching boolean pairs are accepted.

ac6_regression_tests_and_five_suites_gre.proof: All 5 artifact test suites passed with 577 passed and 1 skipped total across the suites.
